title: Leafnode peers can bypass publish permissions for JetStream acknowledgements
summary:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

Leafnode user permissions restrict which subjects a remote leafnode may publish to the hub. JetStream acknowledgements update consumer delivery state.

### Problem Description

Inbound leafnode permission checks exempted JetStream acknowledgement subjects. A leafnode peer could submit acknowledgements outside its configured publish permissions and cause pending work to be acknowledged or terminated. For streams whose retention depends on acknowledgements, this could remove messages without processing by the intended consumer.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.10 and v2.15.3. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.
